zoom: A slow, steady camera push forward through a sunlit Victorian palm house toward a white cast-iron spiral staircase, followed by a smooth pull back that reveals the whole glasshouse around it. The scene is a frozen tableau: every palm frond, fern and climbing leaf is perfectly still and the light never changes. The staircase winds anticlockwise around a slender fluted central column, with pierced lace-like filigree risers, beaded balusters, a curved handrail and a gothic-arched iron gate at its base, rising to a round gallery under the roof. Above it, a tall curved glass roof on cream-painted iron ribs with scalloped overlapping panes and a large diagonal tubular iron beam. Dense Mediterranean fan palms, a tall dark conifer, ferns and broadleaf climbers surround the stair. Bright hazy daylight, soft shadows, warm ivory ironwork and deep greens remain constant. As the camera moves, more of the iron-and-glass structure and the tropical planting are revealed with identical textures and colors, and zero object or environmental movement.
orbit: A slow, steady camera approach toward a white cast-iron spiral staircase inside a sunlit Victorian palm house, then a smooth orbit around the staircase that reveals its far side and the planting behind it.
